scope: The standing Metropolitan Cathedral on Plaza Gerardo Barrios, including its twin open belfries, deep central arch, nave, transepts and crossing dome.

nativeControls.name: Catedral Metropolitana del Divino Salvador del Mundo

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The government visitor guide locates the cathedral on the square, dates the current consecration to 1999 and records 50 m towers and a 45 m dome.
The cathedral owner provides the standing building history, architects and basilican design background.

The Universidad de El Salvador building survey describes the plain post-2011 finish, recessed arch and rose window, metal nave roof and concrete transept roofs, paired drum apertures and rooftop balustrades.
